culprit_citations.quoted_text: Second lien senior secured loan | 6.56 % PIK | LIBOR (M) | 3.44 % | 9/2016 | 3/2024 | 125.6 | 103.6 | 106.8 | (2)

findings.detail: ADG second lien senior secured loan was stored with no interest_rate or basis_spread even though the source shows 6.56 % PIK, LIBOR (M), and 3.44 % spread.

rationale: Class 2 row validation. The flagged extracted row for ADG, LLC and RC IV GEDC Investor LLC, Second lien senior secured loan has blank interest_rate and basis_spread, but the matching raw SOI row is identifiable by issuer context, instrument, maturity 3/2024, amortized cost 103.6, and fair value 106.8. That source row contains coupon 6.56 % PIK, reference LIBOR (M), and spread 3.44 %, so the missing extracted rate fields are a real extraction gap.
